create.name: Ihsan Alexander
create.bio:
Ihsan Alexander (Emil Ihsan Alexander Torabi) teaches the contemplative side of Islam, with dhikr, the practice of remembrance, at its centre. After reading history at the University of California San Diego, he spent around nine years studying Islamic spirituality with a number of teachers, travelling widely as he did so. He places his teaching within the Naqshbandi Sufi line, and for a period he advised the US military on religion and culture, including sensitivity training for Marines.

Since 2011 he has offered the Islamic Meditation Program, an online course in dhikr and meditative prayer, and in 2014 he started the Soul of Islam Radio podcast, whose episodes also appear on his YouTube channel. He works as a faith-based life coach and runs Awakenings Academy, an online community with weekly study circles, live remembrance gatherings and a library of guided meditations, now hosted on his BorderPoint site. His talks are aimed at Muslims and at anyone curious about Islam's inner dimension, and deal with presence in worship, gratitude, the ego, surrender and purifying the heart. He lives in Southern California with his family.

courses.title: Islamic Meditation Program
courses.description: A self-paced online course in dhikr and Islamic meditative practice, with six weeks of video lessons, a manual and a set of guided and meditation audio tracks. Students keep access for life.

courses.title: Awakenings Academy
courses.description: His yearly online membership, bringing together his core courses with weekly study circles, live gatherings for remembrance and companionship, an audio library of guided meditations and a private members' group.

courses.title: Personal Coaching with Ihsan Alexander
courses.description: One-to-one faith-based coaching sessions with him online, offered on a limited basis, singly or as a block of six.
courses.price: $295 USD per session; $1,295 USD for six

free_resources.title: Ihsan Alexander on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His guided meditations on the Insight Timer app, free to play.

free_resources.title: Primer on Islamic Meditation
free_resources.description: A free introductory masterclass and mini-course on meditation within the Islamic tradition, sent by email when you sign up on his site.

free_resources.title: Rediscovering Islamic Spirituality
free_resources.description: A short free series of four videos on the inner dimension of Islam and its forms of meditation, together with a guided meditation track, given on sign-up.

free_resources.title: Soul of Islam Radio
free_resources.description: His long-running podcast of talks on faith, character and spiritual practice, free on the main podcast apps and YouTube.

free_resources.title: Global Dhikr and Meditation Livestream
free_resources.description: Free live online gatherings for remembrance and meditation; you request an invitation, and past sessions can be replayed.
